name: Custom Shape Magnet Bookmark
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from 230 gsm coated paper for a smooth surface and clear printed details.
    - Features built-in magnets inside both panels for secure page holding.
    - Durable construction helps the bookmark keep its shape during regular use.
    - Custom die-cut shape creates a more attractive and personalized look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Opened size: 1.97 in x 6.3 in ~ 5 x 16 cm.
    - Folded size: 1.97 in x 3.15 in ~ 5 x 8 cm.
    - Magnet size: 0.59 in ~ 1.5 cm diameter, 1.16 mm thickness
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality digital printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Used to mark pages securely without easily slipping out.
    - The magnetic closure helps the bookmark clip firmly onto pages.
    - Suitable for books, planners, notebooks, journals, textbooks, and magazines.
    - Helps readers quickly return to the last page they were reading.
    - Slim and lightweight, making it convenient for daily reading and study use.
    - Can also be used as a decorative page marker thanks to its custom-shaped design.
    - A practical choice for students, teachers, book lovers, and office users.
    - Easy to open, fold, and reposition as needed.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Great gift for book lovers and readers.
    - Suitable for students, teachers, classmates, and friends.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Christmas, back-to-school, and holidays.
    - A thoughtful gift for reading clubs, classroom rewards, and small giveaways.
    - Ideal for personalized themes such as name designs, seasonal artwork, cute characters, or memorial keepsakes.
    - Combines both practical function and decorative value, making it a meaningful gift option.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Custom Shape Magnet Bookmark

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.3-0.5 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
